user_prompt: I need to understand which of our products are driving the most cost and why—like breaking down material expenses, design complexity, and whether we're overpaying certain suppliers compared to our benchmarks. Can you show me which items in our portfolio have the most expensive components and where our supply chain dependencies might be creating risk?

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
- corp.itsm: Internal IT service management (incident analysis, asset provisioning, safety incidents)
  - AssetProvisioningOrchestrator: Automates IT asset lifecycle from engineering changes
  - ChangeAutomationOrchestrator: General orchestrator for engineering changes & material provisioning
- sap.ariba: Procurement/supply chain (NEW)
  - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI: PO lifecycle, supplier collaboration, real-time status tracking (PRIMARY for supplier commitments)
  - VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation: Invoice matching to POs & contracts
  - SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor: Vendor risk management, hazardous materials tracking
- sap.crm: Sales/marketing (opportunities, campaigns, compensation)
- sap.odm: Entity type taxonomy (40 canonical business objects)
- emarsys.cx: Customer experience/engagement
- workday.hcm: HR/HCM system
- sap.ehs: Safety/EHS with SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator
- siemens.plm: PLM with EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning agent, BOM validation
  - SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator: Material approval & supplier assessment
- sap.s4: ERP with cost/procurement focus
  - ProcurementMatchingAgent: Vendor cost analysis, pricing comparison, performance metrics, lead times, quality ratings
  - BOMComplianceAutomationAgent: BOM validation, material specifications, supplier qualifications
  - AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator: Engineering change coordination
- my.mes: Manufacturing execution
  - ProductionChangeOrchestrator: Coordinates synchronized updates across production workflows

KEY PATTERNS:
- Supply chain partner visibility & purchase commitments → sap.ariba:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI
- IT infrastructure automation from engineering changes → corp.itsm:AssetProvisioningOrchestrator
- Manufacturing workflow synchronization → my.mes:ProductionChangeOrchestrator
- **PRODUCT COST ANALYSIS & SUPPLIER BENCHMARKING → sap.s4:ProcurementMatchingAgent (evaluates vendor pricing, cost optimization, historical performance)**
- Material design/BOM compliance → sap.s4:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent (validates component specs, supplier qualifications)

args.reason: This agent analyzes vendor pricing, historical performance metrics, and material specifications to identify cost drivers, benchmark supplier costs, and optimize procurement decisions—directly addressing portfolio cost analysis and supply chain risk visibility.
